description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LoanMultiDisbursementException' which extends a platform domain rule exception. It is part of the loan account module in the Fineract project and handles errors related to multiple disbursements in a loan process.

classes.name: LoanMultiDisbursementException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating errors related to multiple disbursements in a loan account.

methods.name: LoanMultiDisbursementException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception with a default user message, prepended with 'error.msg.'.
